title: Replacement Body Panels & Statutory Depreciation Scale
citation: UAE Unified Motor Vehicle Insurance Policy (CBUAE Standard), Chapter 1, Schedule 2 (Depreciation Rates for Parts)
text: When collision repair requires replacement of bolt-on body components (e.g. bumpers, fenders, doors, lamps, or hood), replacement parts shall be sourced from certified OEM or manufacturer-approved suppliers. A statutory depreciation deduction may apply to the cost of new parts based on vehicle age from first registration (up to statutory ceilings), while paint and repair labor are reimbursed in full.
